questions.question: Which statement explains why a large Monte Carlo sample can have a precise mean while individual readings remain variable?
options: Every sample becomes equal to the mean as sample size increases
The variance of each reading is divided by the sample size
The standard error of the average decreases, while the distribution of an individual reading stays the same
questions.explanation: For independent draws the average has variance \(\sigma^2/N\); a new reading still has variance \(\sigma^2\). These are different random variables.
